'''2018 European MPC Results Quirin Fürgut LS Combat Preparedness (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Quirin Fürgut]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Quirin Fürgut]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Tatooine (Coruscant)]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Preparedness (V) Furgut 2.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
